issues.description: The template's ArrayHelpers class defines a method named appendElement(T[] array, T element) while other template classes (e.g., Stock.java) call ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...). The solution uses addElementToArray as well. This name/signature mismatch will cause compilation errors and prevents students from using the provided helper methods as intended.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the ArrayHelpers API consistent across the template and solution. Either rename the method in src/de/tum/cit/ase/ArrayHelpers.java from appendElement(...) to addElementToArray(...) (and keep removeFirstElementFromArray as is), or update all call sites (e.g., src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java and other files) to use appendElement(...). The preferred fix is to rename the template ArrayHelpers method to addElementToArray so it matches the existing usages in the template and the solution.

issues.description: The array helper used to append an element is named inconsistently across artifacts: template/src/de/tum/cit/ase/ArrayHelpers.java defines the method as appendElement(...), while template/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...) and the solution defines addElementToArray(...). This mismatch will cause confusion and compilation errors for students who try to use the provided Stock helpers and follow the solution naming.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method name across artifacts. Either rename the template ArrayHelpers.appendElement(...) to addElementToArray(...) to match Stock.java and the solution, or change the calls in Stock.java to use appendElement(...). The recommended fix is to rename appendElement to addElementToArray in src/de/tum/cit/ase/ArrayHelpers.java so it matches usage and the solution.
